description: Read the graph by `mode`; send only its fields: `node` {target, relation?, page?}; `path` {path (not a node id), relation?, page?}; `history` {runRef, afterCursor?, limit?}; `input` {consumer, planRef, declarationId, candidateKey?, afterCursor?, maxBytes?}. `relation`: card/children/neighbours/executions/checks. Or `{ memory: { v: 1, op: lookup|neighbors|history|conflicts } }`. Returns nodes/edges/lines/Session refs; Goal/scope/identity bound.
